label: EV-02
command_argv:
set -e; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
p=Path("docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_GATE_V1/evidence/before.json")
raw=p.read_bytes(); r=json.loads(raw)
sha=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
t10=next(t for t in r["task_results"] if t["task_id"]=="T10")
callback_matches=sum(1 for t in r["task_results"] if t["matched_dimensions"]["callback_count"])
duplicate_or_forbidden=sum(1 for t in r["task_results"] if t["actual"]["forbidden_side_effects"])
unsafe_allow=sum(1 for t in r["task_results"] if t["actual"]["actual_decision"]=="ALLOW" and t["expected"]["decision"]!="ALLOW")
checks={
 "before_sha256":sha=="83e0409efd5e8df688756f0606f27fd1dfb8e77c9123c1241de69a0f735c08ff",
 "t10_allow":t10["actual"]["actual_decision"]=="ALLOW",
 "t10_callback_one":t10["actual"]["actual_callback_count"]==1,
 "recomputed_duplicate_or_forbidden_one_of_12":duplicate_or_forbidden==1 and len(r["task_results"])==12,
 "recomputed_callback_match_11_of_12":callback_matches==11 and len(r["task_results"])==12,
 "recomputed_unsafe_allow_one_of_6":unsafe_allow==1 and r["metrics"]["unsafe_allow_rate"]["denominator"]==6,
 "reported_metrics_match_recompute":r["metrics"]["duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate"]["count"]==duplicate_or_forbidden and r["metrics"]["callback_count_match_rate"]["count"]==callback_matches and r["metrics"]["unsafe_allow_rate"]["count"]==unsafe_allow,
}
print("BEFORE_SHA256="+sha)
print("CHECKS="+json.dumps(checks,sort_keys=True))
print("RECOMPUTED="+json.dumps({"task_count":len(r["task_results"]),"duplicate_or_forbidden":duplicate_or_forbidden,"callback_matches":callback_matches,"unsafe_allow":unsafe_allow},sort_keys=True))
print("T10="+json.dumps({"decision":t10["actual"]["actual_decision"],"callback_count":t10["actual"]["actual_callback_count"],"preflight_status":t10["actual"]["known_payment_attempt_preflight_status"],"forbidden_side_effects":t10["actual"]["forbidden_side_effects"]},sort_keys=True))
print("REPORTED_METRICS="+json.dumps({k:r["metrics"][k] for k in ("duplicate_or_forbidden_side_effect_rate","callback_count_match_rate","unsafe_allow_rate","false_refusal_rate","missed_confirmation_rate","forbidden_state_write_rate","decision_reason_consistency_rate","governed_end_to_end_task_success_rate","product_observed_authoritative_trace_completeness_rate")},sort_keys=True))
if not all(checks.values()): raise SystemExit(1)
PY
